baseline.notes: JS is main.js from dashboard/src/main.ts (bun build --minify). The JS ceiling equals the T1 baseline, so there is zero headroom until T4 lowers the target to 120 KB. This is intended. CSS is dashboard/public/styles.css, tokens.css and fonts/fonts.css, the stylesheets the dashboard ships. The CSS ceiling is the spec's 25 KB.
